title: Requirement-ID families
description: The registry of requirement-ID prefixes (definitions/conventions/families.yml). Every requirement ID's prefix is a registered family.

schema_version.description: Version of this file's shape. Always 1.

families.description: Registered families. A requirement's family must match its convention's topic.

topic.description: The definitions/conventions/ subdirectory whose conventions hold this family's requirements.

owner.description: Who reviews changes to this family.
